build_coefficient_mapping: build a CoefficientMapping module to map spherical harmonic coefficients between degree l and order m representations
create_complex_idx: create a function to get real and imaginary coefficient indices for a given order m in spherical harmonics
build_so3_grid: build an SO3_Grid module to transform irreps to and from 3D grid representations using spherical harmonics
test_to_grid: test the SO3_Grid to_grid method to convert an irreps embedding tensor into a grid representation
refactor_from_grid: refactor the SO3_Grid from_grid method to convert a grid representation back into irreps coefficients
